cases.case: Same Terrain3D project after one-line EditorDock cleanup patch

finding: Terrain3D asset_dock.gd detaches its EditorDock from the editor but does not release that parent. The child is freed separately in editor_plugin.gd. Adding _dock.queue_free() removes the four ObjectDB/CanvasItem/texture leaks in the same isolated project. Both extension-only/editor-plugin-disabled controls crashed on this pinned local engine; the enabled Terrain3D before/after comparison is the evidence for the cleanup patch. The production project keeps both editor plugins enabled.
